description:
LLMBatchGateway is the Schema for the llmbatchgateways API.
It represents a fully-managed deployment of the LLM-D batch gateway,
consisting of an API server, a request processor and a garbage-collector.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Spec defines the desired state of LLMBatchGateway.

apiServer.description: APIServer configures the HTTP API server component.

config.description: Config holds fine-grained API server configuration.

batchAPI.description: BatchAPI configures the batch job submission endpoint behaviour.

eventTTLSeconds.description: EventTTLSeconds is how long job events are retained before expiry.

extraEndpoints.description:
ExtraEndpoints overrides spec.extraEndpoints for the API server.
Leave unset to inherit spec.extraEndpoints; an explicit empty list disables
deployment-specific endpoints for the API server.

passThroughHeaders.description: PassThroughHeaders is a list of HTTP request headers forwarded to the inference backend.

enablePprof.description: EnablePprof enables the Go pprof profiling HTTP endpoints.

fileAPI.description: FileAPI configures the file upload/download endpoint behaviour.

defaultExpirationSeconds.description: DefaultExpirationSeconds is the default TTL for uploaded files.

maxLineCount.description: MaxLineCount is the maximum number of lines allowed in a JSONL batch input file.

maxSizeBytes.description: MaxSizeBytes is the maximum allowed size of a single uploaded file.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: IdleTimeoutSeconds is the maximum amount of time to wait for the next request.

inputHeaders.description:
InputHeaders maps logical header roles to HTTP header names used for tenant
identification and other input metadata (e.g. {"tenant": "X-MaaS-Username"}).

logging.description: Logging configures log verbosity for the API server.

verbosity.description: Verbosity sets the log verbosity level (higher means more verbose).

observabilityPort.description: ObservabilityPort is the TCP port that exposes metrics and health endpoints.

port.description: Port is the TCP port the API server listens on.

readTimeoutSeconds.description: ReadTimeoutSeconds is the maximum duration for reading an entire HTTP request.

writeTimeoutSeconds.description: WriteTimeoutSeconds is the maximum duration before timing out writes of the response.

imagePullPolicy.description:
ImagePullPolicy overrides the image pull policy for the API server container.
Useful for development workflows where the image is loaded directly into the cluster node.

replicas.description:
Replicas is the desired number of API server pods.
Setting this to 0 suspends the API server; the Ready condition will be False.
Every replica must be ready before the component is reported Available.

resources.description: Resources defines CPU and memory requests/limits for the API server container.

claims.description:
Claims lists the names of resources, defined in spec.resourceClaims,
that are used by this container.

This field depends on the
DynamicResourceAllocation feature gate.

This field is immutable. It can only be set for containers.

items.description: ResourceClaim references one entry in PodSpec.ResourceClaims.

name.description:
Name must match the name of one entry in pod.spec.resourceClaims of
the Pod where this field is used. It makes that resource available
inside a container.

request.description:
Request is the name chosen for a request in the referenced claim.
If empty, everything from the claim is made available, otherwise
only the result of this request.

limits.description:
Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

requests.description:
Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.
If Requests is omitted for a container, it defaults to Limits if that is explicitly specified,
otherwise to an implementation-defined value. Requests cannot exceed Limits.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/manage-resources-containers/

dbBackend.description:
DBBackend selects the database backend used for job state storage.
The batch-gateway control plane uses PostgreSQL. The async processor's
request/result queues use a separate transport, configured under
processor.asyncConfig.redis or processor.asyncConfig.sql.

extraEndpoints.description:
ExtraEndpoints adds deployment-specific inference paths to the standard
OpenAI Batch API allowlist for both the API server and processor.
The batch-gateway processes validate each path at startup.

fileStorage.description:
FileStorage configures the file storage backend used to persist batch
input/output files. Exactly one of s3 or fs must be configured.

fs.description: FS configures PVC-backed filesystem storage. Mutually exclusive with s3.

basePath.description: BasePath is the root directory inside the PVC where files are stored.

claimName.description: ClaimName is the name of the PersistentVolumeClaim to mount.

retry.description: Retry configures retry behaviour for transient file storage errors.

initialBackoff.description: InitialBackoff is the wait duration before the first retry (e.g. "1s").

maxBackoff.description: MaxBackoff is the maximum wait duration between retries (e.g. "10s").

maxRetries.description: MaxRetries is the maximum number of retry attempts. Set to 0 to disable retries.

s3.description: S3 configures S3-compatible object storage. Mutually exclusive with fs.

accessKeyId.description:
AccessKeyID is the S3 access key ID (non-sensitive). The corresponding
secret access key must be provided via spec.secretRef.

autoCreateBucket.description: AutoCreateBucket causes the operator to create the bucket if it does not exist.

bucket.description:
Bucket is the S3 bucket name used for all file storage.
Tenant isolation is achieved via S3 key prefixes, not separate buckets.

endpoint.description: Endpoint overrides the S3 endpoint URL for non-AWS providers (e.g. SeaweedFS).

prefix.description: Prefix is an optional key prefix applied to all objects written to the bucket.

usePathStyle.description: UsePathStyle forces path-style addressing (required by some S3-compatible stores).

x-kubernetes-validations.message: exactly one of fileStorage.s3 or fileStorage.fs must be set

gc.description: GC configures the garbage-collector component that expires old jobs and files.

dryRun.description: DryRun causes the GC to log what it would delete without actually deleting anything.

logging.description: Logging configures log verbosity for the GC.

verbosity.description: Verbosity sets the log verbosity level (higher means more verbose).

maxConcurrency.description: MaxConcurrency is the maximum number of deletion operations performed in parallel.

reconciler.description:
Reconciler configures the orphan reconciler that detects and cleans up
stale jobs missed by the normal collector sweep.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether the orphan reconciler runs.

interval.description: Interval is both the scan frequency and the staleness threshold (e.g. "60m").

imagePullPolicy.description:
ImagePullPolicy overrides the image pull policy for the GC container.
Useful for development workflows where the image is loaded directly into the cluster node.

interval.description: Interval is how often the GC runs (e.g. "30m").

replicas.description:
Replicas is the desired number of GC pods.
Setting this to 0 suspends the GC; the Ready condition will be False.
Every replica must be ready before the component is reported Available.

resources.description: Resources defines CPU and memory requests/limits for the GC container.

grafana.description: Grafana enables the bundled Grafana dashboard ConfigMap.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether a Grafana dashboard ConfigMap is created.

httpRoute.description: HTTPRoute configures a Gateway API HTTPRoute resource to expose the API server.

annotations.description: Annotations are extra annotations applied to the HTTPRoute resource.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether an HTTPRoute resource is created.

parentRefs.description: ParentRefs is the list of Gateways this HTTPRoute should attach to.

items.description: ParentReference identifies a Gateway to which an HTTPRoute should attach.

name.description: Name is the name of the Gateway resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the Gateway resource. Defaults to the HTTPRoute's namespace.

sectionName.description: SectionName is the name of a specific listener on the Gateway to attach to.

imagePullSecrets.description:
ImagePullSecrets is a list of references to secrets for pulling container images
from private registries. Applied globally to all component pods (apiServer, processor, gc).

items.description:
LocalObjectReference contains enough information to let you locate the
referenced object inside the same namespace.

name.description:
Name of the referent.
This field is effectively required, but due to backwards compatibility is
allowed to be empty. Instances of this type with an empty value here are
almost certainly wrong.
More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

monitoring.description: Monitoring enables Prometheus ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor resources.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether a ServiceMonitor and PodMonitor are created for each component.

otel.description: OTEL configures OpenTelemetry tracing for all components.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is the OTLP gRPC or HTTP endpoint (e.g. "http://collector:4317").

insecure.description: Insecure disables TLS for the OTLP connection.

postgresqlTracing.description: PostgresqlTracing enables tracing of PostgreSQL operations.

redisTracing.description: RedisTracing enables tracing of Redis operations.

sampler.description: Sampler is the OTEL sampler type (e.g. "parentbased_traceidratio").

samplerArg.description: SamplerArg is the argument passed to the sampler (e.g. "0.1" for 10% sampling).

processor.description: Processor configures the request-processing worker component.

asyncConfig.description:
AsyncConfig configures the async-processor deployment that dispatches
batch inference requests to inference gateways through an async queue
transport (Redis or PostgreSQL SQL).

concurrency.description: Concurrency is the number of concurrent inference requests the processor dispatches.

drainTimeout.description: DrainTimeout is the maximum time to wait for in-flight requests during shutdown (e.g. "2m").

imagePullPolicy.description: ImagePullPolicy overrides the image pull policy for the async-processor container.

inferenceGateway.description:
InferenceGateway configures the connection to the inference gateway
EPP (EndpointPicker) service where inference requests are sent.

url.description: URL is the base URL of the inference gateway (e.g. "http://gateway.svc:8000").

modelServerMonitor.description: ModelServerMonitor configs a PodMonitor that scrapes model server metrics.

prometheusCacheTTL.description: PrometheusCacheTTL is the cache duration for Prometheus query results (e.g. "30s").

prometheusURL.description: PrometheusURL is the URL of a Prometheus instance for gate metrics queries.

redis.description: Redis configures the Redis message queue backend.

batchSize.description: BatchSize is the number of requests to dequeue per poll cycle.

gateParams.description: GateParams provides parameters for the gating mechanism.

gateType.description: GateType specifies the dispatch gating mechanism (e.g. "prometheus-saturation", "redis-quota").

pollIntervalMs.description: PollIntervalMs is the polling interval in milliseconds for the Redis queue.

queuesConfig.description:
QueuesConfig is a list of per-queue configurations.
When set, overrides the single-queue settings (RequestPathURL, GateType, etc.)
and must cover every request queue the processor publishes to, which is
derived from processor.modelGateways.
When omitted, one queue per processor.modelGateways entry is derived,
named llm-d-async:requests:<inferencePoolName> unless the model sets
requestQueueName; the single-queue settings above apply to each of them.

items.description: AsyncQueueConfig configures a single async-processor request queue.

gateParams.description: GateParams overrides the gate parameters for this queue.

gateType.description: GateType overrides the gating mechanism for this queue.

igwBaseURL.description: IGWBaseURL overrides the top-level asyncConfig.inferenceGateway URL for this queue.

name.description: Name is the transport-specific request queue name.

requestPathURL.description: RequestPathURL overrides the request path for this queue.

workerPoolID.description:
WorkerPoolID assigns this queue to a named worker pool.
Must match a workerPools[].name entry. Defaults to "default" if omitted.

requestPathURL.description: RequestPathURL is the path appended to the inference gateway URL for requests.

replicas.description:
Replicas is reserved for the future desired number of async-processor pods.
It is currently ignored: the upstream llm-d-async chart hardcodes replicas to 1.
Setting this field, including 0, does not change or suspend the async processor.
It will take effect only after the upstream chart templates it from values.

resultPollTimeout.description:
ResultPollTimeout is the maximum time the batch-gateway processor waits
for an async dispatch result before timing out (e.g. "30s").

sql.description:
SQL configures the PostgreSQL SQL message queue backend.
Redis and SQL are mutually exclusive; async dispatch requires one of them.

batchSize.description: BatchSize is the number of requests to dispatch per poll cycle.

handoffTimeoutSeconds.description: HandoffTimeoutSeconds bounds graceful partition handoff during processor shutdown.

leaseTTLSeconds.description: LeaseTTLSeconds controls SQL partition lease expiry after a processor stops heartbeating.

maxConnections.description:
MaxConnections caps the SQL connection pool for each Batch Gateway
processor replica (async_dispatch.max_connections). It is separate from
the async processor dispatcher's own SQL pool.
When omitted, the chart default (8) applies. Explicit values must be positive.

pollIntervalMs.description: PollIntervalMs is the interval in milliseconds for polling SQL queues.

queuesConfig.description: QueuesConfig configures SQL request queues and their dispatch gates.

items.description: AsyncQueueConfig configures a single async-processor request queue.

gateParams.description: GateParams overrides the gate parameters for this queue.

gateType.description: GateType overrides the gating mechanism for this queue.

igwBaseURL.description: IGWBaseURL overrides the top-level asyncConfig.inferenceGateway URL for this queue.

name.description: Name is the transport-specific request queue name.

requestPathURL.description: RequestPathURL overrides the request path for this queue.

workerPoolID.description:
WorkerPoolID assigns this queue to a named worker pool.
Must match a workerPools[].name entry. Defaults to "default" if omitted.

resultBatchSize.description: ResultBatchSize is the maximum number of results written per transaction.

tls.description: TLS configures TLS for connections to inference gateways.

caCertKey.description:
CACertKey is the key in SecretName holding a custom CA certificate used to
verify the inference gateway.

certKey.description:
CertKey is the key in SecretName holding the client certificate for mutual
TLS. Requires keyKey.

insecureSkipVerify.description:
InsecureSkipVerify disables verification of the inference gateway's TLS
certificate. Not recommended for production; prefer caCertKey.

keyKey.description:
KeyKey is the key in SecretName holding the client private key for mutual
TLS. Requires certKey.

secretName.description:
SecretName is the name of the Secret, in the LLMBatchGateway's namespace,
that holds the CA certificate and optional client certificate/key. Its
keys are selected with caCertKey, certKey and keyKey below.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: tls.secretName is required when tls.caCertKey, tls.certKey or tls.keyKey are set
tls.certKey and tls.keyKey must both be set or both be empty

transformConfig.description: TransformConfig modifies request bodies before forwarding to the inference gateway.

workerPools.description: WorkerPools defines named worker pool configurations.

items.description: AsyncWorkerPool defines a named worker pool configuration for the async-processor.

gateParams.description: GateParams provides parameters for the gating mechanism.

gateType.description:
GateType specifies the dispatch gating mechanism for this pool
(e.g. "prometheus-saturation", "prometheus-budget", "redis-quota").

workers.description: Workers is the number of concurrent workers in this pool.

concurrency.description: Concurrency groups all dispatch-rate and concurrency control knobs.

aimd.description: AIMD holds adaptive concurrency control parameters.

additiveIncrease.description:
AdditiveIncrease is the number of concurrency slots added after a full
window of consecutive successes per endpoint.

backoffFactor.description:
BackoffFactor is the multiplicative decrease applied to the per-endpoint
concurrency limit when the endpoint signals overload (429/5xx).
Must be a decimal in (0, 1), e.g. "0.5".

enabled.description:
Enabled controls whether AIMD adaptive concurrency is active.
When false, per-endpoint concurrency is fixed at ConcurrencyConfig.PerEndpoint.

min.description:
Min is the floor for per-endpoint adaptive concurrency.
AIMD will never reduce a single endpoint's effective limit below this value.

global.description:
Global limits total in-flight inference requests across all workers.
Acts as a fixed ceiling — the sum of all per-endpoint concurrency is
bounded by this value.

perEndpoint.description: PerEndpoint is the initial and maximum concurrency per inference endpoint.

recovery.description: Recovery limits concurrent job recoveries during startup.

defaultOutputExpirationSeconds.description: DefaultOutputExpirationSeconds is the TTL for job output files.

enablePprof.description: EnablePprof enables the Go pprof profiling HTTP endpoints.

extraEndpoints.description:
ExtraEndpoints overrides spec.extraEndpoints for the processor.
Leave unset to inherit spec.extraEndpoints; an explicit empty list disables
deployment-specific endpoints for the processor.

inputFileDiskBudgetPercent.description:
InputFileDiskBudgetPercent is the percentage of the processor work directory
reserved for local input copies when calculating effective worker capacity.

logging.description: Logging configures log verbosity for the processor.

verbosity.description: Verbosity sets the log verbosity level (higher means more verbose).

numWorkers.description: NumWorkers is the number of concurrent worker goroutines processing jobs.

progressTTLSeconds.description:
ProgressTTLSeconds is retained for API compatibility. The upstream
processor now writes progress to PostgreSQL and does not use this field.
Deprecated: use progressUpdateInterval.

progressUpdateInterval.description:
ProgressUpdateInterval is the interval between intermediate progress writes
to PostgreSQL.

resumable.description: Resumable holds tunables for the resumable batch pipeline.

finalizeConcurrency.description: FinalizeConcurrency bounds parallel result-object fetches during finalization.

finalizeTimeout.description: FinalizeTimeout is the budget for one resumable finalization attempt.

leaseDuration.description:
LeaseDuration is the PostgreSQL ownership lease held by an activated batch.
The owning processor renews the lease at half this interval.

routeKeyMethod.description:
RouteKeyMethod controls how modelGateways lookup keys are built.
Empty uses the model ID. "tenant" uses "<tenantID>/<modelID>".

sendFairnessHeader.description:
SendFairnessHeader controls whether the processor sends a fairness header
to the inference gateway for fair scheduling across tenants.

dispatchMode.description:
DispatchMode is retained so manifests written before synchronous dispatch
was removed keep applying; the operator always dispatches asynchronously
and ignores the value.

Deprecated: async is the only supported value. Remove this field from new
manifests; setting it to "sync" is rejected, and resources that still use
synchronous dispatch must be drained and re-deployed as async.

imagePullPolicy.description:
ImagePullPolicy overrides the image pull policy for the processor container.
Useful for development workflows where the image is loaded directly into the cluster node.

additionalProperties.description: ModelGatewaySpec maps a model to the async dispatch pool that serves it.

inferenceObjective.description:
InferenceObjective specifies the scheduling objective for this model
(e.g. "throughput", "latency").

inferencePoolName.description: InferencePoolName identifies the async dispatch pool for this model.

requestQueueName.description:
RequestQueueName is the async request queue used by the async processor.
It is a Redis sorted-set key or a SQL queue name, depending on
asyncConfig.redis or asyncConfig.sql.
Set together with resultQueueName to override the queue derived from inferencePoolName.

resultQueueName.description:
ResultQueueName is the async result queue base used by the async processor.
The processor appends its replica identity to this base. It is a Redis list
key or a SQL queue name, depending on asyncConfig.redis or asyncConfig.sql.
Set together with requestQueueName.

modelGateways.description:
ModelGateways maps model names to their async dispatch pool.
Each entry must include an inferencePoolName.

enabled.description: Enabled controls whether a PrometheusRule resource is created.

labels.description:
Labels are additional labels applied to the PrometheusRule resource,

secretRef.description:
SecretRef references the Kubernetes Secret that holds runtime credentials
(database URL, S3 keys, inference API key, etc.).

When Namespace is omitted the Secret must reside in the same namespace as
the LLMBatchGateway CR.

When Namespace is set to a different namespace, a Gateway API ReferenceGrant
must exist in that namespace permitting this LLMBatchGateway to reference
the Secret. The controller will copy the Secret into the CR's namespace
under a managed name (<gateway-name>-credentials) so that the workload
Pods can mount it.

SecretRef is immutable after creation. To use a different Secret, delete
and recreate the LLMBatchGateway CR.

namespace.description: namespace defines the space within which the secret name must be unique.

CertManager configures automatic certificate provisioning via cert-manager.

secretName.description:
SecretName is the name of an existing TLS Secret (type kubernetes.io/tls)
containing the certificate and key. Mutually exclusive with certManager.

readyReplicas.description:
ReadyReplicas is the number of replicas that have passed their readiness
checks, capped at Replicas. It is reported as 0 while the workload is still
rolling out, following the same conditions as kubectl rollout status: the
controller has not observed the latest spec, not every desired replica runs
the current pod template, an outdated replica is still present, or the pod
template revision is still changing. A non-zero value therefore means the
rollout finished.

conditions.description:
Conditions represent the latest available observations of the LLMBatchGateway's state.
Known condition types: Ready, APIServerAvailable, ProcessorAvailable, GCAvailable.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the .metadata.generation that was last processed by the controller.
